text:
Vik: quick idea  console should recommend rollout cohorts automatically based on affected-route size + historical p99 sensitivity.
Sam: love it. algorithm sketch?
Vik: if routes<5 -> suggest [100%], if routes 5-50 -> [1%,10%,100%], if >50 -> [0.1%,1%,10%]. weight by historical p99 delta per route.
Noor: how do we compute "historical p99 sensitivity" cheaply? we can use rolling aggregate `route_slo_sensitivity` from the last 7d.
SRE: keep metric low-cardinality: store route_slo_sensitivity in our TSDB as top-1000 by traffic and write route as label only for those. others roll into "other" bucket.
Vik: console UI: show recommended cohorts + short explanation "based on 7d route sensitivity and affected QPS" and an expand to list top 10 risky routes.
Sam: telemetry: emit `config_recommendation_total{strategy="cohort_v1"}` and a histogram `recommendation_confidence`. avoid snapshot_id label.
Noor: add a small machine-readable field in API: GET /v1/configs/{id}/recommendations -> {"cohorts":[0.1,1,10,100],"reason":"..."}. console uses it.
Vik: ops policy: auto-recommendations are advisory. force requires preflight + ops ticket if recommended 100% skip.
ops-bot: created ticket REC-21 to track cohort recommendations integration and owners @Vik,@Noor.
SRE: note on cardinality: recommendation should reference route_ids only in logs/traces. metrics keep only cohort_bucket label to aggregate.
Sam: timeline: Noor will prototype API + aggregator this week, Vik will add UI hook next sprint. follow-up in REC-21.
Vik: thanks everyone. small follow-up: include estimated cost-delta per cohort in the recommendation response.
Noor: will add est_cost_cents_by_cohort.
SRE: final: guard against noisy routes; smooth sensitivity with exponential decay 0.3.
Vik: perfect. moving to REC-21. :rocket:
